# nocthost_servers (Data Source)

All servers on the account that are not destroyed (`GET /servers`). Requires an API token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nocthost_servers" "all" {}

output "server_ips" {
  value = { for s in data.nocthost_servers.all.servers : s.label => s.ipv4 }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `servers` (Attributes List) Servers, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))

<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `hourly_price` (Number) Price per hour in USD.
- `id` (String) Server ID.
- `image` (String) Installed OS or app.
- `ipv4` (String) Public IPv4 address.
- `label` (String) Server name.
- `plan_id` (String) Size ID.
- `provider_id` (String) Cloud backend ID.
- `region_id` (String) Region code.
- `status` (String) Server status.
